notes.title: Abandoned Factory
notes.content:
This update includes:

New Level - Abandoned Factory.
Head bob has been added for more realistic movement.
The flashlight has had a makeover.
CLOWN can now jump up onto obstacles to get to the player and is smarter in general.
Improved lighting and atmosphere.


See ya soon!

notes.title: Maps
notes.content:
This update includes:

Minimaps have been added to all 3 existing levels.
A large map (can be accessed by pressing "M") has been added to the Twisted Forest level.
Character will automatically stop crouching when player starts to sprint.
Bug fixes regarding the flashlight specifically.
Minor bug fixes here and there.

More obstacles and items have been added to the Twisted Forest level. I will be adding more in the next couple of days.


Thank you to those who provided suggestions for things they'd like to see.
See ya soon!
